title: Identify Cryptic Binding Site with Mixed Solvent MD Simulation and SiteMap
authors: Da Shi; Dmitry Lupyan; Steven Jerome; Robert Abel; Yuqi Zhang
one_liner_zh: 该文用混合溶剂MD模拟与SiteMap识别蛋白隐蔽结合位点，虽涉及蛋白口袋与MD方法，但对象为小分子药物结合位点而非蛋白质-DNA互作，与TF-DNA课题关联较弱。
abstract: A comprehensive study was conducted to address the challenge of identifying cryptic binding sites in proteins, which are crucial for structure-based drug discovery but are often not apparent in apo protein structures. We developed and validated a novel "induce and identify" workflow that integrates mixed solvent molecular dynamics (MxMD) simulations with SiteMap. This approach leverages MxMD sampling of protein conformations to expose hidden pockets, which are then effectively identified and ranked by SiteMap. Using a challenging dataset of 65 cryptic binding sites, the developed workflow identified the cryptic binding site within the top 5 predictions in 78.5% of cases. We believe the proposed MxMD + SiteMap workflow offers a robust and valuable tool for early-phase drug discovery, enabling the exploration of a broader range of druggable targets by effectively inducing and identifying cryptic binding sites.
abstract_zh: 为应对蛋白质中隐蔽结合位点识别的挑战，开展了一项全面研究，这些位点对于基于结构的药物发现至关重要，但在脱辅基蛋白质结构中往往不明显。我们开发并验证了一种新颖的“诱导与识别”工作流程，该流程整合了混合溶剂分子动力学（MxMD）模拟与SiteMap。此方法利用MxMD对蛋白质构象的采样来暴露隐藏口袋，随后由SiteMap有效识别并排序。使用包含65个隐蔽结合位点的挑战性数据集，所开发的工作流程在78.5%的案例中将隐蔽结合位点识别在前5个预测之内。我们认为，所提出的MxMD + SiteMap工作流程为早期药物发现提供了稳健且宝贵的工具，通过有效诱导和识别隐蔽结合位点，能够探索更广泛的药物靶点范围。
